title: 潜在结构的可操作性：容量、响应性与对齐
summary: 研究语言模型激活空间中潜在结构的因果影响力，提出其由容量、响应性和对齐三因素共同决定。实验表明因果有效性需三因素均高，且因果性依赖上下文而非结构固有属性。基于此提出因果探针，在概念引导上提升17%-118%。
summary_en: This paper investigates what makes latent structures in LM activation space actionable, framing causal influence as a product of three factors: capacity, responsiveness, and alignment. Across 4 LM families and 50 concepts, causal effectiveness requires all factors to be high, and causality is context-dependent rather than intrinsic. Restricting linear probe training to a causally effective subspace yields causal probes with 17%-118% steering improvement.
